schema.taxBasis: included|excluded_with_documented_fixed_or_percentage_charges|unknown; companion feeNormalization fields are mandatory authority
schema.additional: feeNormalization defines exact source fields/arithmetic for fixed and percentage charges. Preserve atomic rows and explicit source evidence. allMandatoryChargesDocumented is boolean based on source statement, not collector confidence. Add aggregate records {aggregateId,cityId,venueId,measure,constituentAtomicRowIds,sourceUrl,provisionalEligibility,normalizationStatus,reason}; no invented prices. Actions use provenance schema.
schema.sourceBasisEvidence: Explicit source statement or null establishing mandatory-charge inclusion/exhaustiveness. Shared25-word source excerpt allowance; no inferred tax convention. Required for complete normalization.

aggregateSchema: Exact fields:aggregateId,cityId,venueId,measure,constituentAtomicRowIds,sourceUrl,provisionalEligibility,normalizationStatus,reason. Include all eligible ordinary-main rows for that venue; preserve excluded/uncertain rows outside aggregate and all genuine disputes.
disputeSchema: Exact fields:id,aggregateId(null|string),atomicRowIds(array),sourceUrls(array),competingInterpretations(array),evidence(string),reason(string). Log real contradictions/application disagreements; missing tax alone is uncertainty.

referenceWindow.stageWindow: Reference acquisition finishes within seven days of its first dispatch. Paired fresh methods finish within72 hours of one another and within seven days of reference acquisition. Violations invalidate promotion under this matched-window design; preserve descriptive results.
referenceWindow.latestStart: 2026-11-10; later work needs prospective date redesign and separate evidence stratum
referenceWindow.oldFx: Validate old responses at their original dispatch time, never bypass freshness. Use original frozen evaluation FX for the six old currencies so descriptive replays are comparable. Model-returned FX is not the scoring conversion.

retrievalPolicy: one search then ranked original-source opens; no retries
provenanceAuthority: Coordinator-selected metadata, not independent worker attestation
referenceDate: 17–20 November 2026 (three nights; food/drink prices current in October–November 2026)
